create_shearx_transform: create a ShearX transform to horizontally shear images, bboxes, masks, and segmentation maps
create_sheary_transform: create a ShearY transform to vertically shear images, bboxes, masks, and segmentation maps
create_rotate_transform: create a Rotate transform to rotate images, bboxes, masks, and segmentation maps by an angle

create_translaty_transform: create a TranslateY transform to vertically translate images, bboxes, masks, and segmentation maps
